summary: BP p.l.c. furnished a Form 6-K on 30 October 2026 containing its third-quarter and nine-month 2026 results, not a transaction announcement. Reported figures include third-quarter profit attributable to shareholders of $4,696 million, underlying replacement cost profit of $8,458 million, operating cash flow of $14,829 million and net debt reduced by $8.4 billion to $13,870 million. An announced dividend of 8.660 cents per ordinary share was declared. The release notes the Gelsenkirchen refinery divestment, Deepwater Horizon settlement acceleration with Louisiana, and a strategy update scheduled for 15 December. No special-situations terms were stated.
